observations.body: Death in trespasses is followed by being made alive, forgiveness, removal of the written record, nailing it to the cross, and disarming rulers and authorities.

observations.body: The passage keeps written record, cross, rulers visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Colossians 2:13–15 as its own the cross in letters and later memory crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This later passage uses Crucifixion language inside its own argument without retelling the complete Gospel event.
